fact: The ANDF baseline study (30 December 2025) says transactions formalised on the ANDF platform covered 226,028 parcels, that e-Notaire connected 771 notaries for mutation requests, and that only authorised providers, not the public, can use the platforms apart from cadastre.bj.
title: Étude baseline TERRA, rapport définitif
publisher: Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier (ANDF)
